justifications.durability: The added test classes are focused and the negative control demonstrates the guard fires rather than merely passing. It loses points because the merge query's Cypher map lookup $database_sources[database] is exercised only through a mocked GraphClient and never against a live database (repo rule: default markers exclude graph), so a Cypher that failed to parse would pass the suite, and because an unintegrated rule leaves a re-ingest of the handbook unmarked with no regression to catch it.
justifications.evidence: The fragment carries a figure, a live measure through the pipeline's own functions (apply_dynamic_page_rule then link_chunks_to_entities, not hand Cypher) with the 12400-to-6298 brief growth reconciled, and a negative control (negative_control.log EXIT=1 reds test_header_only_without_database_is_not_dynamic, negative_control_head.log EXIT=0 3 passed). justifications.fit: The page reaches its signals through the existing WikiChunk-[:DOCUMENTS]->FacilitySignal relationship and the existing link_chunks_to_entities writer, so no new edge and no new edge-owner is introduced, and WikiPageStatus is not widened: the page keeps status 'ingested'. The pure helpers are named by mechanism and exported. It loses points because the rule is not integrated into any production path: apply_dynamic_page_rule and detect_dynamic_page have zero call sites outside tests and __all__ (see finding call-site).
justifications.goal_fidelity: The change realises the three mechanisms plan section 3 names minus the PID pass that belongs to the dynamic-page sibling node: extract_database_links parses ?db= from stored chunk text, detect_dynamic_page marks a header-only table fronting a known database, and link_chunks_to_entities gains a fourth DOCUMENTS merge keyed on fronts_database. On the live graph CategoryInformation carries ['EDDB','PMDB'] and DataInformation ['UDDB','EQDB','FAME'], both ingested, database_signals_linked=12596, and jt-60sa:general/psrc_magfluxlp1 is reached from both chunks of the EDDB page (apply_live.log Q1-Q4). It loses points because only 2 of the seven handbook tables were marked: apply_discover.log shows a third linking topic CategoryInformation2 fronting LCDB and MBDB, absent from the applied set and from apply_live.log Q1, and the wiki scorer still scores a dynamic page as content (see finding corpus).
